cluster_rule: Connected components of complete sessions, original conversation IDs and QA memory-chain/source lineage; unknown lineage quarantined
exposure_rule: Exclude any connected component intersecting prior opened/protected source IDs; do not treat shared tool schemas as shared tasks
ordering: SHA256(compact sorted UTF-8 JSON of goal, seed, neutral cluster ID); ascending hash
confirmation_rule: Last ceil(cluster_count/3) in frozen hash order; never open bodies
task_per_cluster: Minimum SHA256(goal, seed, neutral task ID); never choose by answer/tool/complexity
eligibility: Fixed released QA and complete long-session history map unambiguously
Independent source lineage and no protected/exposed overlap
Query and normal supplied tool schema separable from evaluator fields
Action-intent output and complete parameter scoring contract can be frozen

r1_policy.note: Shared evidence envelope enlarged after user removed token-spending restriction. Full H first if it fits; no answer-driven truncation. Reader full context checked against actual model context.

oracle: Evaluator-selected exact original spans, no labels in online payload; validity fixed before generation
identical_input_alias: Only complete identical payload bytes before generation; one correlated observation
